Local copies of the report dependencies already used by this project.

- tailwind-runtime.js: https://cdn.tailwindcss.com (Tailwind CSS, MIT)
- chart.umd.js: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js (Chart.js 4.6.1, MIT; license banner retained)

The reader substitutes these paths in memory. Original report HTML files and their standalone downloads remain unchanged.
